$comment: VDP conformance vectors, spec revision vdp-spec-0.3. Language-agnostic: SPEC.md section 10. Each vector replays a sequence of actions against `policy` from q0 = (0, 0) (state tuple order follows policy.counters declaration order: [spend, checks]) and asserts the automaton's per-step decision and state. A conforming implementation MUST reproduce every `expect` block exactly. Both counters here are amount-summing (counting: false) -- see counting-counters.vectors.json for call-counting semantics (SPEC.md section 2.1a).

vectors.name: whitelist_violation
vectors.description: pay to a target outside the whitelist. Target is not in T at all, so alpha sinks it before delta runs (fail-closed, unconditional).

vectors.name: prohibited_verb
vectors.description: delete_account is an unconditional hard prohibition.

vectors.name: unknown_verb
vectors.description: A verb never named in phi. Not in V, so alpha sinks it.

vectors.name: cumulative_cap_then_resume
vectors.description: The spend counter is monotone and cumulative: a BLOCK leaves state unchanged, and a later action that fits the remaining headroom is still allowed. Demonstrates a block does not poison the counter, and that splitting cannot beat a cumulative cap.

vectors.name: no_target_verb_unrestricted_target
vectors.description: check_status has a counter but no whitelist clause, so any target in T is accepted for it (whitelist clauses constrain only their own verb) — including NO_TARGET (the empty string) and a target that only appears in pay's whitelist.

vectors.name: amount_saturation_and_negative
vectors.description: A negative amount and an amount above c_max (1000) both saturate to the out-of-range sink, independent of any per-counter bound.
